Name: (Cp) Haae Tree Retexture
Author: haae1020
Description:
[color=#d4d4d8][b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
This mod changes the tree texture in Stardew Valley. It replaces the original tree appearance with a custom design while keeping all in-game functionality unchanged. This is purely a visual retexture and has no impact on gameplay.

[b][size=5]Installation Guide[/size][/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Install Content Patcher.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Download this mod and extract the files.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Add this folder into the Stardew Valley > Mods.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Launch the game using SMAPI.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b][size=5]Features[/size][/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Replaces the default tree sprite with a custom texture.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Uses Content Patcher for safe and compatible asset replacement.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]No changes to gameplay mechanics or balance.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Lightweight visual retexture mod.[/color][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][b][size=5]Requirements[/size][/b][/color]

[list]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Stardew Valley[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]SMAPI (latest version recommended)[/color][/*]
[*][color=#d4d4d8]Content Patcher[/color][/*]
[/list][line]
